```yamlfile
name: CI - Linux - GNU

permissions:
  contents: read

on:
  pull_request:
    paths:
      - '**'
      - '!README.md'
      - '!doc/**'
      - '!.**'
      - '.github/workflows/CI-linux-gnu.yml'
  push:
    branches:
      - v[0-9].*
      - master

jobs:
  build-gnu-cross:
    runs-on: ubuntu-24.04
    container:
      image: ubuntu:26.04
      options: --privileged
    timeout-minutes: 30
    name: arm-linux-gnueabi (cross)

    steps:
      - name: Install git
        run: |
          apt-get update
          apt-get install -y git
        env:
          DEBIAN_FRONTEND: noninteractive

      - uses: actions/checkout@de0fac2e4500dabe0009e67214ff5f5447ce83dd # v6.0.2

      - name: Install arm-linux-gnueabi Toolchain
        run: |
          apt-get install -y autoconf automake libtool make \
                             g++-14-arm-linux-gnueabi \
                             qemu-user \
                             abigail-tools
        env:
          DEBIAN_FRONTEND: noninteractive

      - name: Configure with arm-linux-gnueabi-gcc-14
        run: |
          set -x
          autoreconf -i
          mkdir build
          cd build
          ../configure --build=$(config/config.guess) \
                       --host=arm-linux-gnueabi \
                       --with-testdriver="$(pwd)/libtool execute $(pwd)/../scripts/qemu-test-driver" \
                       --enable-debug
        env:
          CC: arm-linux-gnueabi-gcc-14
          CXX: arm-linux-gnueabi-g++-14

      - name: Build
        run: |
          make -C build -j$(nproc)
        env:
          CFLAGS: "-Wall -Wextra -g -Og -fstrict-aliasing -Wstrict-aliasing -Werror=strict-aliasing"

      - name: ABI Check
        run: |
            srcdir=$(pwd)
            cd build/tests
            ./check-namespace.sh

      - name: Test
        run: |
          set -x
          bash -c 'echo core.%p.%p > /proc/sys/kernel/core_pattern'
          ulimit -c unlimited
          cd build
          make check -j$(nproc) LOG_DRIVER_FLAGS="--qemu-arch arm" \
                     QEMU_LD_PREFIX="$CROSS_LIB" \
                     LDFLAGS="-L$CROSS_LIB/lib"
        env:
          UNW_DEBUG_LEVEL: 4
          CROSS_LIB: /usr/arm-linux-gnueabi

      - name: Upload Test Logs
        if: failure()
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@v7
        with:
          name: logs-arm-linux-gnueabi
          path: |
            **/test-suite.log
            **/config.log
          if-no-files-found: warn
```
